title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #16 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. "Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin" means (1 mark)
   A. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   B. Say: He is Allah, the One
   C. I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
   D. Allah is the greatest

2. What does Surah Al-Ikhlas teach us most? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth saves people
   B. We should fight our neighbours
   C. Allah is One and has no equal
   D. Prayer is not needed

3. Zawadi prays on time but shouts at her brother. What is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Good prayer should go with good manners
   B. Shouting is a Sunnah
   C. Prayer is wrong
   D. Nothing is wrong

4. A friend gives you back too much change by mistake. What would a person of the Prophet's character do? (1 mark)
   A. Spend it on sweets
   B. Return the extra money
   C. Keep it quietly
   D. Tell others to do the same

5. Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Because he lived in the mountain
   B. Because he was afraid
   C. Because they trusted him
   D. Because he was the richest

6. In the hadith about eating, from which part of the dish should we eat? (1 mark)
   A. The part directly in front of us
   B. The other person's side
   C. The middle
   D. Any side we like

7. What should we say after finishing a meal? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Amin
   C. Alhamdulillah
   D. Inna lillahi

8. Who was the boy taught the manners of eating in the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   B. Abu Jahl
   C. Bilal
   D. Ali as an old man

9. Who recorded the syllabus hadith about brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Abu Lahab
   C. Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   D. Khadija

10. Which habit protects teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing toothbrushes
   B. Eating sweets all day
   C. Brushing twice a day
   D. Never rinsing

11. Why should a Muslim not cheat in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Referees are strict
   B. Cheating is fun
   C. Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   D. Cheating is a Sunnah

12. Which of these is a benefit of exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Less sleep
   B. More diseases
   C. Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   D. Weak bones

13. What should we do to use Allah's names in dua? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Stay silent
   C. Call on other beings
   D. Call on Him with the name that matches our need

14. What does "Al-Basir" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Hearing
   B. The All-Seeing
   C. The King
   D. The Most Merciful

15. Which is true about angels? (1 mark)
   A. They are humans
   B. They are jinn
   C. They are honoured servants of Allah
   D. They are gods

16. Which duty belongs to Jibril? (1 mark)
   A. Taking souls
   B. Blowing the Trumpet
   C. Recording deeds
   D. Bringing revelation

17. What is the correct way to mention an angel's name? (1 mark)
   A. Say "alayhis-salam"
   B. Say nothing
   C. Insult
   D. Say "S.A.W."

18. Which surah verse says angels do not disobey Allah's command? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 66:6
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:2

19. What is patience? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   C. Giving up
   D. Getting angry

20. Eid al-Adha reminds us of the obedience of (1 mark)
   A. Nuh and Lut
   B. Musa and Harun
   C. Adam and Hawa
   D. Ibrahim and Ismail

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

22. Why is betting in a game not allowed? (3 marks)

23. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

24. Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life. (4 marks)

25. Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness. (3 marks)

26. State three values learned from participating in sports. (3 marks)

27. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)

28. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)

29. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

30. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   This is the second verse of Al-Fatiha.

2. C — Allah is One and has no equal
   The surah declares the oneness of Allah.

3. A — Good prayer should go with good manners
   The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals as well.

4. B — Return the extra money
   Honesty means returning what is not yours.

5. C — Because they trusted him
   He was called Al-Amin.

6. A — The part directly in front of us
   The hadith says "eat what is directly in front of you".

7. C — Alhamdulillah
   Alhamdulillah thanks Allah for the food.

8. A — Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   He lived in the Prophet's home.

9. C — Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   The syllabus names Ibn Majah.

10. C — Brushing twice a day
   Regular brushing prevents cavities.

11. C — Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   Honesty applies in games too.

12. C — Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   Exercise strengthens the body.

13. D — Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   Allah told us to call on Him by His names.

14. B — The All-Seeing
   Al-Basir sees everything.

15. C — They are honoured servants of Allah
   Angels are creations of light.

16. D — Bringing revelation
   He delivered the Qur'an.

17. A — Say "alayhis-salam"
   We say peace be upon him.

18. A — Qur'an 66:6
   Surah At-Tahrim 66:6 states this.

19. B — Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   Patience is steady calm.

20. D — Ibrahim and Ismail
   It remembers the sacrifice of a ram.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each value.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.
